scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,open -c blue,green,magenta "node scripts/backend-dev.mjs" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "node scripts/open-dev.mjs --port 3000 --port-max 3010"
scripts.dev:reinstall: concurrently -n backend,frontend,open -c blue,green,magenta "node scripts/backend-dev.mjs --force-install" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "node scripts/open-dev.mjs --port 3000 --port-max 3010"
